_meta.description: AGG_DISTINCT_SUM on repeated_measures.pulse, where every subject contributes one row per condition. Params.distinct_by=subject_id sums the metric ONCE PER SUBJECT (first value observed for a subject wins), against a plain AGG_SUM that adds all three rows per subject. AGG_DISTINCT_COUNT on the same key shows the denominator behind it — the same figure AGG_DISTINCT_SUM publishes as its distinct_count component from one scan.
_meta.name: distinct_sum_per_subject
